_comment: Single source of truth for the pinned copy of Annex 1. common/annex.py reads this file; common/bench_schema.py, common/statute_list.py, common/statute.py, the paper02_bench scripts and the release packaging take the amendment date, file names and SHA256 from it. When Annex 1 is amended, add the new PDF to data/statute/ and edit only this file (re-verification steps: paper02_bench/README.md).
instrument: Enforcement Rule of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act, Annex 1 (List of Endangered Wildlife)
instrument_ko: 야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별표 1 (멸종위기 야생생물)
amending_ordinance: Ministry of Environment Ordinance No. 1010 (환경부령 제1010호), promulgated and in force 2022-12-09
expected_totals_source: Ministry of Environment (Biodiversity Division), press release of 9 December 2022, '멸종위기 야생생물, 267종에서 282종으로 개정', attached PDF (https://www.korea.kr/common/download.do?fileId=197531828&tblKey=GMN; copy data/statute/moe_press_release_2022-12-09_endangered_wildlife_282.pdf, SHA256 19c7f5912d64d5aef5799d2b62ddc80824be018189f57b633d931db2d66efab5), page 3: 'I급 68종과 Ⅱ급 214종 등 최종 282종', and the table by group on page 4. Transcribed changes: data/statute/amendment_2022_expected_changes.json.
